name: places100-easy
description: places100-easy is an easy subset of the Places scene-recognition benchmark intended for quick evaluation of image classification models on common scene categories. It measures a model's ability to correctly classify scene types from photographic images using a constrained (easy) set of 100 categories. The benchmark is useful for fast prototyping and benchmarking transfer learning approaches on scene recognition.
reputation: Used as a lightweight, easy-to-run scene-recognition testset derived from the Places family; well known for quick benchmarking though less prominent than full-scale Places variants.
